prompt: Subject: a smartphone camera's live view of an everyday kitchen counter / home corner, used as the full-screen camera feed behind object-detection UI. Scene: light oak counter against a soft off-white wall; clearly separated objects: a potted Monstera plant (upper left), a matte white ceramic mug (center), a small chrome espresso machine without any logo (upper right), and a pair of over-ear headphones lying on the counter (lower middle-right). Style: photorealistic, natural phone-camera photo, slight depth of field, not glossy stock. Composition: portrait; objects in the upper and middle part with space between them so bounding boxes don't overlap; the bottom ~35% is calm, mostly plain counter surface for a UI card. Lighting & mood: soft warm daylight from a window on the left, calm and bright. Palette: warm neutrals, cream, light wood, one natural green from the plant. Avoid: people, faces, hands, brand logos, any text or labels, neon, dark dramatic light, clutter.

Subject: a smartphone camera's live view looking into an open under-sink kitchen cabinet, used as the full-screen camera feed behind step-by-step repair AR guidance. Scene: a white PVC P-trap (U-shaped sink siphon) clearly visible in the upper-middle of the frame, with two large white plastic slip nuts (one where the tailpipe meets the trap at top, one where the trap meets the wall drain pipe on the right); a couple of small water droplets on the lower slip nut; chrome shut-off valves on the back wall at left; clean light wood cabinet floor in the lower part. Style: photorealistic, natural phone-camera photo, sharp detail on the pipe and nuts, slight depth of field. Composition: portrait; trap and nuts in the top 55% of the frame, centered and large; the bottom ~40% is calm empty cabinet floor (space for a UI card). Lighting & mood: bright, even, soft light like a phone flashlight plus daylight, clean and calm, not grimy. Palette: whites, light wood, chrome, warm neutral. Avoid: people, hands, faces, brand logos, any text or labels, mold, dirt, clutter, dark moody light.

Subject: a smartphone camera's live view of a single lat pulldown machine in a modern bright gym, seen from the front, used as the full-screen camera feed behind AR coaching overlays. Scene: the machine is empty (nobody on it); clearly visible parts: the long wide pulldown bar hanging on a cable at the top, a padded seat with a seat-height adjustment knob/pin under it, padded thigh roller pads above the seat, and the weight plate stack with a selector pin on the side. Style: photorealistic, natural phone-camera photo, sharp detail on bar, pads, pin and weight stack, slight depth of field on the background gym. Composition: portrait; the machine centered and filling the top ~60% of the frame (bar near the top, seat around the middle); the bottom ~40% is calm plain light floor (rubber gym floor) for a UI card. Lighting & mood: bright, clean daylight from large windows, calm and airy, not dramatic. Palette: matte black and light grey metal, light grey floor, white walls, warm neutral daylight. Avoid: people, faces, hands, brand logos, any text, numbers or labels on the machine or weight plates, neon, dark moody light, clutter, mirrors with reflections of people.

Subject: a smartphone camera's live view looking down into the open engine bay of an ordinary modern compact car, used as the full-screen camera feed behind step-by-step AR guidance. Scene: clean engine bay seen from the front, top-down at a slight angle; clearly separated, recognizable parts: a bright yellow oil dipstick loop handle (center-right), a black round oil filler cap on top of the engine cover (center), a translucent white coolant reservoir with pinkish fluid (upper left), a blue washer-fluid cap (lower left), and the car battery with red and black terminals (upper right). Style: photorealistic, natural phone-camera photo, sharp detail on caps and handles, slight depth of field. Composition: portrait; all parts in the top ~60% of the frame, well separated; the bottom ~40% is the calm, plain dark-grey front bumper/radiator cover area for a UI card. Lighting & mood: soft even daylight, clean and calm, not greasy. Palette: neutral greys and black engine plastics, with small accents of yellow, blue and the pink coolant. Avoid: people, hands, faces, car brand logos or badges, any text, numbers or warning labels, dirt, dramatic light, clutter.
